name: Autumn (Harvesting and Wine Tasting), from The Four Sea…
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Autumn (Harvesting and Wine Tasting), from The Four Seasons” by Jan Saenredam (c. 1595), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 267805. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
